dimensions.name: Graph correctness
dimensions.description: Validates dependencies and preserves earlier-batch ordering.

dimensions.name: Capacity and determinism
dimensions.description: Respects the capacity and produces stable output.

dimensions.name: Failure handling
dimensions.description: Rejects malformed input and cycles clearly.

dimensions.name: Production judgment
dimensions.description: Explains persistence, retries, and estimate drift.

score_bands.90-100: Correct, deterministic, well-tested plan with mature operational reasoning.
score_bands.75-89: Correct core plan with minor validation or scale gaps.
score_bands.60-74: Material dependency, capacity, or cycle weaknesses.
score_bands.0-59: Does not produce a safe dependency-aware plan.
